decisions.reason: The digital anamnesis and consent app line is the firm's flagship, and the pandemic and wider digitalization of dental practices have only increased demand for paperless patient intake.
The continuing education institute supports customer loyalty and the firm's training business at moderate cost, though it sits further from core software and may be reorganized.
Remote screen sharing support became even more essential during the pandemic and is a cheap backbone of efficient customer service.
A practice performance analytics dashboard builds on the data in the core software and fits the firm's direction toward efficiently managed practices.
The complete practice bundle is mainly a packaging of existing offerings, so it is cheap to maintain, though it could be restructured into new package names.
The job and practice listing portal is distant from the core business and faces strong competition, but its low running cost and value for customer engagement likely keep it alive for now.
